receipt_plumbing_issue: The CLI parsed both command-line thresholds but the dispatcher omitted them from benchmark_real_expert_microwork, so the raw receipt recorded null thresholds. The benchmark payloads, timings, correctness, memory, lifecycle, shutdown, and health data are unaffected.
inspection: Four-way ownership halves worker model state but selected-expert imbalance (2 to 6 hits per contacted worker) prevents the predicted 35% critical-path reduction. Extra messages also raise mean framed transport from 259522.667 bytes at two workers to 289550.6 bytes at four.
bottleneck: Routing imbalance plus per-worker process/transport fixed cost, not expert arithmetic correctness.
redesign: Test eight workers for the required scaling curve with a weaker, evidence-based prediction: worker footprint below 12%, exactness retained, and same-GPU complete-layer throughput at least 65%; do not require proportional compute scaling.
